quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' championship DNA and competitive resilience
quotes.excerpt: they are a championship team, so they have championship DNA and we just wanted to fight

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: This one was hard fought, was it not? What a wild, how do you describe the swings in this game?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: It was a tough game. We knew that they were going to make runs. They are a championship team, so they have championship DNA and we just wanted to fight through their runs and just keep competing and keep staying together.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' resilience after a back and forth game: They are a championship team so they have championship DNA and we just wanted to fight through their runs and keep competing.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu discusses the competitive nature of the game and the resilience shown by his team against their opponents.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the Timberwolves' second unit impact and team response
quotes.excerpt: we let their non-shamen, if they won their non-shamen in the first half, we were up 10

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: It felt like you guys were in a really good rhythm in that first quarter, and then it all kind of went away. How did you guys end up getting it back, like midway through the third?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: We let their non-shamen, if they won their non-shamen in the first half, we were up 10 and their second unit really changed the game for them. So we wanted to harp on that for our team in the second half and do the same thing and we made a great run in the third quarter, we were able to finish the game out in the fourth.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu explains the second half turnaround: We wanted to harp on that for our team in the second half and do the same thing and we made a great run in the third quarter.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu explains how his team adjusted their defensive approach against the opponent's second unit to regain momentum in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on stepping up as primary ball-handler after LaMelo Ball's injury
quotes.excerpt: I always been ready for anything and you know that's my mindset just being able to adapt

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Were you ready when LaMelo went down with the ankle to be the primary ball-handler?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: For sure. I mean, you know, I always been ready for anything and you know that's my mindset just being able to adapt to any situation. I'm praying for LaMelo, hopefully it's nothing too serious and we got the win for him.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on stepping up as the primary ball handler following the LaMelo Ball injury: I always been ready for anything and you know that is my mindset just being able to adapt to any situation.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu addresses his role as the primary ball-handler following an ankle injury sustained by LaMelo Ball during the game.
